name: Ubiflow
positioning: The French multi-portal distribution layer — one feed in, every portal out, with the format differences absorbed.
description: Ubiflow is a listing distribution platform for French real estate professionals: it takes a catalogue from an agency's software or a developer's system and publishes it to portals, partner sites and marketplaces, normalising formats and reporting on performance per channel.
real_estate_use: France has no MLS, so distribution is a job in itself: each portal has its own format, its own media rules and its own contract. Ubiflow absorbs that. An agency or a promoteur maintains one catalogue, and gains a per-portal view of leads and cost — which is the data needed to decide which subscriptions to renew.
features: Single feed distribution to French portals and partner sites
Format normalisation and media handling per channel
Lead consolidation and per-portal performance reporting
Publication rules and quota management per contract

use_cases.job: Publish one catalogue to every portal and see which subscription actually pays
Distribute a new-build programme across portals and partner networks
